featuredProjects.name: Contract Code Security Audit Platform
featuredProjects.summary: Worked on contract-code security-audit engineering at Gate, focusing on source retrieval, audit-flow orchestration, structured risk output, and stability issues in long-running analysis jobs.

metrics.label: audit results stayed traceable and reusable

details: Handled multichain contract-source retrieval, normalization, and preprocessing to feed downstream audit stages with stable inputs.
Split the audit flow into traceable stages so long-running jobs could be retried, observed, and recovered more cleanly.
Worked on Redis lifecycle issues, task management, and monitoring visibility so the platform stayed stable over time.
This was where my earlier systems experience shifted into security-audit and backend engineering work.
featuredProjects.achievement: This is the most recent and most grounded part of my work history: not a big narrative, just making an audit workflow stable, readable, and durable.

featuredProjects.name: Air Spring Quality Inspection System
featuredProjects.summary: Owned air-spring reinforcement-layer inspection from image processing and model training through PLC integration, with the real goal of stable production use instead of a one-off demo.

metrics.label: built for stability, not a demo

details: Worked on multilayer image inspection for inner layer, outer layer, and distance measurement while improving onsite stability.
Tuned preprocessing, ROI logic, and thresholds for industrial-camera images so the system could keep up with the real production rhythm.
Connected model outputs to PLC logic so defect decisions could enter downstream factory actions.
Spent a lot of time on false-positive review and iteration because continuous usability mattered more than presentation quality.
featuredProjects.achievement: This project made it clear that I am best suited to the kind of vision work that needs repeated iteration until it truly survives production.

featuredProjects.name: Monocular Safety Distance Measurement System
featuredProjects.summary: Worked on monocular distance estimation and warning for power-safety scenarios, moving from simple 2D mapping toward more stable scene-reconstruction ideas to reduce false alarms and keep the workflow usable onsite.

metrics.label: results fed directly into safety flow

details: Started from pixel-to-distance mapping and gradually introduced geometric constraints and scene-understanding ideas to improve stability.
Handled changing lighting, camera angles, and limited information from single-view images with a focus on real failure cases.
Integrated the result into a mobile warning flow so frontline workers could use it directly in the field.
Because the cost of a wrong warning was high, the engineering priority stayed on reliability and interpretability.
featuredProjects.achievement: This is the kind of project I remember for a long time because the algorithm was not just a model result, it affected real safety decisions.

featuredProjects.name: Motion Analysis & Capture Project Set
featuredProjects.summary: Spent several years on motion recognition, sports capture, and realtime video-analysis projects where most of the work was repeated tuning, failure review, and making the pipeline stable in real tests.

metrics.label: main tools used in recognition and processing
constant balance of speed and stability

details: Worked on golf analysis, motion capture, and other realtime vision prototypes and deliveries.
Combined detection, segmentation, and post-processing to balance speed, robustness, and usability.
Tested with real users and kept adjusting thresholds, ROIs, and deployment steps.
These projects were not flashy, but they show the strongest part of my foundation.
featuredProjects.achievement: This group of work gave me the most solid base I have: how to move a vision model from merely running to actually being useful.
